name: tessie
description: Connect Tessie to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Tessie MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Tessie to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with tesla vehicle data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Tessie workspace.
Find anything in Tessie that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review tesla vehicle data in Tessie.
